name: Check Reference Processing Complete
plugin_description: Sync medications, pharmacies, and providers from call transcripts to Contact records
action_description: Queries each reference object (drug, pharmacy, provider) for records linked to the given phone call that still have a blank status. Field IDs are resolved dynamically from field names — no manual UUID configuration required.

inputs.name: call_summary_name
inputs.label: Call Summary Name
inputs.description: Name of the call summary record to check

outputs.name: is_complete
outputs.label: Is Complete
outputs.description: True if all ref types have zero unprocessed records for this call
